subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “A store worker explained that the label was not meant to make every decision for customers.”?
options: The event showed that raw information without context can mislead.
It was meant to give one more piece of information.
The homework was not meant to make students love money.
The app had guessed too much from too little information.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A store worker explained that the label was not meant to make every decision for customers. It was meant to give one more piece…」，答案為「It was meant to give one more piece of information.」。
